scope: five real Tasks8 queue adapters plus real work_summary_payload migration, synthetic fresh source and prepared EMPTY Tasks20 target only
constructor_boundary: Original full fresh source constructor; target only _ensure_initialized bypass after explicit empty Tasks replacement; original constructor attributes, _open_connection, _connect and immediate transaction bodies retained
external_action_guard_boundary: Python audit hook rejects socket connections/subprocesses/os.system during constructors and public calls. Dependencies import first because croniter platform.architecture may invoke local file metadata utility; no Agent/provider CLI is invoked.
fixture_connection_instrumentation: Native sqlite3.Connection subclass records actual execute.rowcount and trace; existing connect args/PRAGMAs remain. Same-connection stale-leaf seam injects only an explicit fixture write immediately before original CAS SQL; separate actual competing-writer lock control. No application method body or SQL is reimplemented.
normalization: No new Task12 rows seeded: published-eight row identities, physical pointers, values/types and State lease facts compare exactly without ID normalization.
Payload bodies represented by exact stored-byte SHA256/type/length and decoded SHA256; no semantic-only equality.
limitations: No nonempty migration, actual production profile, copied preserved rows, inverse/current-fact/predecessor/reforward/cold target constructor/native/UI/final11 proof.
Other six external-writer modules and native scheduled-definition queue are not public-tested; this covers five adapter classes over four relevant Tasks kinds and their input children.
Explicit fixture triggers force native UPDATE IGNORE and lease-write ABORT. Readonly/provider/native/worker behavior is outside scope; no worker, provider or CLI is started.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE prevents a concurrent committed change during a batch. Stale-leaf CAS uses a disclosed same-transaction injection, not a claimed successful concurrent writer.

negative_control.mutation: Only original summary CAS RHS column becomes outer structural payload_json instead of generated business leaf; SET and actual routine unchanged
